detailed_description: Signature Pad lets you draw a signature in the browser on an HTML canvas. Use a mouse, stylus, or touch screen, choose a pen color and width, set a solid or transparent background, then download the drawing as PNG or SVG. The SVG export embeds the canvas image rather than converting strokes into editable vector paths. This tool creates a reusable signature image only; it does not verify identity, apply signatures to documents, encrypt files, manage signing workflows, or determine whether a signature is legally binding.
usage_steps: Choose a pen color and adjust the pen width.
Select a background color or enable a transparent background.
Draw your signature on the canvas with a mouse, stylus, or touch screen.
Use Clear if you want to start over.
Download the finished signature as PNG or SVG.
usage_examples: Create a PNG signature image to place into an invoice or letter.
Draw a transparent-background signature for use in a document editor.
Save a quick SVG wrapper around the canvas image for design handoff.
Redo a signature with a different pen width or color before downloading.
